📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-09
1. DeepMind Unveils AlphaGenome Atlas, a Predictive Map of 9 Billion DNA Variants研究
DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，預先計算90億種DNA變異
Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome Atlas, a roughly 1-petabyte dataset that precomputes molecular effect predictions for about 9 billion possible single-nucleotide variants across the human genome. Researchers can query the atlas via a website or API instead of running the AlphaGenome model themselves.
Google DeepMind發布AlphaGenome Atlas，預先計算人類基因組約90億種可能的單一核苷酸變異，建立約1PB的變異預測資料集。研究人員可透過網站與API直接查詢DNA變異的分子影響，不必自行執行AlphaGenome模型。

2. Microsoft's September Patch Tuesday Sets Record With Nearly 1,000 Fixes資安
微軟9月例行更新破記錄修補近1,000個自家產品漏洞
Microsoft's September Patch Tuesday fixed 974 vulnerabilities carrying its own CVE identifiers, more than double last month's 421. Including 25 third-party component flaws, the total reaches 999 vulnerabilities patched.
微軟9月例行更新一共修補974個自家登記CVE編號的漏洞，較上月421個多出一倍。若再加上25個第三方元件弱點，漏洞總數將達到999個。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Claude Multi-Agent System Formalizes Fermat's Last Theorem Proof in 11 Days模型
原估需數年，Claude多代理系統11天完成費馬最後定理形式化證明
Anthropic announced that a Claude Code-based multi-agent system completed the first fully machine-checkable formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean in just 11 days, a task previously estimated to take years. The effort produced about 13 million lines of Lean code and 30,300 proven theorems, of which 29,500 were used in the final proof.
Anthropic公布費馬最後定理形式化成果，以Claude Code為基礎的多代理系統花11天，首次完成可由Lean證明助理從頭到尾檢查的形式化證明。整項工程產生約1,300萬行Lean程式碼，完成30,300項定理證明，最終證明使用29,500項。
iThome · 原文連結
4. US/Canada Court Case Management Platform Breach Exposes Sensitive Records資安
美加法院案件管理平臺資料外洩，敏感個資與機密資料恐受影響
Thomson Reuters' court case management platform C-Track suffered a data breach after a third party gained unauthorized access to court files. Exposed data may include names, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, medical and health insurance information, and some sealed or confidential court records.
Thomson Reuters旗下法院案件管理平臺C-Track發生資料外洩，第三方未經授權取得部分法院檔案。外洩資料可能包含姓名、社會安全碼、駕照號碼、出生日期、醫療及健康保險資訊，部分機密或封存資訊也可能受影響。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Cognition Hits $48B Valuation as Investors Bet Big on AI Coding產業
Cognition估值衝上480億美元，投資人押注AI編碼市場非贏家全拿
AI coding startup Cognition has reached a $48 billion valuation, a higher multiple than Cursor commanded before its sale to SpaceX. The deal signals investors believe the AI coding tools market is far from winner-take-all.
AI程式編碼新創Cognition估值衝上480億美元，倍數高於Cursor出售給SpaceX前的水準。這筆交易顯示投資人認為AI編碼工具市場遠非贏家全拿的局面。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
6. Meta Debuts Muse, a Personal AI Agent Betting on Deep Data Access產品
Meta發表個人AI代理Muse，盼消費者交出信任
Meta unveiled Muse, a personal AI agent designed to handle tasks like selling a car or booking a flight by requesting access to users' email, calendars, payments, and health services. The launch is Meta's biggest consumer AI bet yet and a major test of user trust in the company's data practices.
Meta推出個人AI代理Muse，訴求可代勞賣車、訂機票等任務，但需要存取用戶的電子郵件、行事曆、付款與健康服務等資料。此舉是Meta迄今最大的消費者AI賭注，也考驗使用者對該公司資料處理的信任。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
7. Power Users Sue Anthropic Over Alleged Subscription Bait-and-Switch政策
AI重度用戶指控Anthropic訂閱方案誤導，提告求償
Some Anthropic power users are taking the company to court, alleging they were misled into believing a top-tier subscription plan would deliver more usage than it actually did. Anthropic has said power users are central to its business, prioritizing them even at the cost of cutting off other popular third-party applications.
部分Anthropic重度用戶對該公司提起訴訟，指控被誤導以為頂級訂閱方案能提供更多用量，實際上卻並非如此。Anthropic曾表示重度用戶是公司業務核心，甚至不惜為此切斷其他熱門第三方應用程式的存取。
The Verge · 原文連結
8. Mistral Raises €3B as Sovereign AI Becomes Big Business產業
Mistral完成30億歐元募資，主權AI成為熱門生意
French AI lab Mistral has raised €3 billion at a €21 billion valuation in a Series D round led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe, and PSG Equity. The raise underscores growing investor appetite for "sovereign AI" ventures outside the US.
法國AI實驗室Mistral完成由三星、Scaleup Europe與PSG Equity領投的D輪募資，金額達30億歐元，估值來到210億歐元。這輪募資顯示主權AI已成為美國以外投資人青睞的熱門生意。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
9. OpenAI Shares AI-Generated Solution to Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem模型
OpenAI公布Navier-Stokes千禧年大獎難題的AI解答，隨即掀起學界爭議
OpenAI announced that its AI agents produced a solution to the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem, one of mathematics' Millennium Prize Problems, complete with a writeup and a formal proof in Lean. The claim has since drawn accusations of impropriety from academics, with a $1 million bounty attached to the problem.
OpenAI宣布其AI代理提出Navier-Stokes存在性與光滑性問題（千禧年大獎難題之一）的解答，並附上論文與Lean形式化證明。這項聲明隨後引發學界質疑其做法不當的爭議，該題附帶100萬美元獎金。
OpenAI · 原文連結
10. Palo Alto Networks: AI Agents Breached a Corporate Network in Under 10 Hours資安
Palo Alto Networks揭露攻擊者利用AI代理10小時內攻破企業網路，竊取root憑證
Palo Alto Networks researchers disclosed a network intrusion in which attackers used a top AI model paired with a dedicated agent framework to complete an attack chain that would normally take about two weeks of human effort in under 10 hours. The attackers relied on speed gains from AI agents rather than any novel zero-day exploit.
Palo Alto Networks研究人員揭露一起企業網路入侵事件，攻擊者利用頂尖AI模型及專用AI代理框架，在不到10小時內完成原本需人力約兩週的入侵流程。研究人員指出，攻擊者並未使用全新零時差漏洞，而是靠AI代理大幅提升攻擊速度。
